baselineScope: Frozen HEAD generation and prompt sources; shared current provider transport/DSL/runtime dependencies
measurement: Static geometry plus actual ReadonlySlideCanvas Chromium measurements; human acceptance remains separate
media: No image generation or TTS calls; exact diagram/data evidence supplied as text; no teaching course persisted.
environmentLimits: Tail conditions overlapped six additional action-generation calls to the same model and production builds on the shared host. Provider/system load was not isolated. Timing figures are observed request durations, not dedicated-environment benchmarks or billing totals.
baselineInterpretation: Fixed Git commit baseline. It excludes the uncommitted accept-after-one-correction change present when this session began, so it does not represent the complete initial workspace or deployed behavior.

resumeEvidence.rationale: The original runtime is reused. Only the obsolete live-source fingerprint calculation and baseline recompilation call are bypassed. All saved result files are retained; model and sample hash checks remain active.
resumeEvidence.interruptionAccounting: Logical call and elapsed-time totals include saved result records only. Requests in flight when the environment stopped may have reached the provider but their completion and billing cannot be established; they are not counted as confirmed completed calls.

callAccounting: Saved logical requests only; transport retries and unpersisted requests in flight at environment interruption are not a provider billing total.
interpretation: Counts without rule warnings are diagnostic, not human acceptance. First response and final content are measured separately; no-vision cases are unavailable, not model quality failures.
